blocks.text: Maya has sold her business. Part of the money will pay taxes in six months. The rest is for her family's future. She meets a financial professional and starts asking the questions that matter before investing.

Follow her case to understand the Series 63 concepts in context: who is acting, which rules apply, what the professional owes the client and what happens when a transaction is questioned. The people and firms are fictional; the situations reflect everyday securities business.
